note.label: Hope Amid Destruction

precepts.why:
Isaiah 33:16 says the one who walks righteously “shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks”. His place of defence is the kingdom, and Isaiah 2 shows what the munitions of rocks are.

“And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills”. The mountain of the Lord's house is the highest government on earth, literally. “and all nations shall flow unto it.”

“And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law”. That is what goes forth out of Zion: the law.

So to dwell on high is to dwell in that kingdom, set above every other government, and that is the promise to the one who meets the stipulation of Isaiah 33:15. There, “bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.”

The day of the Lord is upon everyone that is proud and lofty, and they shall be brought low, as those kings were brought out of the cave with the feet of the captains of Israel upon their necks.

note.label: Joshua 10: The Day the Sun Stood Still

A future prophecy.

“In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats; To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.” That is why Joshua said, “Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the Lord do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.” What he did to those five kings he shall do to all the enemies of Israel when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

note.label: Psalm 46: God Is Our Refuge and Maketh Wars to Cease

precepts.why:
“he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.” Isaiah says the same as Micah: “he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.”

Two prophets, one word: wars cease when the Most High judges among the nations. Right now he has not stopped the wars, so this is a prophecy not yet come; we are in the beginning of sorrows. But it is coming, and the God of Jacob is our refuge until it does.

points: We’re still dealing with thy kingdom come. “The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.”

note.label: ​ | Sabbath Evening Class: Secrets in the Lord's Prayer

points: “That the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains”. We look at movies like Thor and The Hobbit for the scenery and the majesty of the kingdoms they have imagined, but the Bible says the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be in the top of the mountains. There shall be no government higher than the nation of Israel. When you see Israel you’re going to have to look up; it ain’t going to be in the valley. All eyes on the planet are going to be right there: the highest mountain on the planet, higher than Mount Everest. “And shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it”: that’s still talking about Israel.

note.label: ​ | Sabbath Evening Class: Secrets in the Lord's Prayer

points: “And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law”. So why can’t the churches understand, out of Zion shall go forth the law? Why is it always some Christian garbage rhetoric about Christmas and Thanksgiving? The Bible says the law is going to go forth out of Zion.
Verse 3 is not talking about the other nations, because the other nations are referenced in verse 4. These many people that come up to learn the law are Israel.

note.label: ​ | Sabbath Evening Class: Secrets in the Lord's Prayer

points: “And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people”: here are the other nations; that’s how you know verse 3 is not talking about them. “And they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks”: those are farming instruments. “Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.”

Verse 4 is talking about war. He’s going to send the 144 thousand to subdue all nations. You want peace on earth? The 12 tribes of Israel must be established in the earth and subdue the nations. There ain’t going to be no peace until that is established.

note.label: ​ | Sabbath Evening Class: Secrets in the Lord's Prayer

points: “O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the Lord.” It comes back to the house of Jacob: that’s the same thing verse 3 was saying. Come ye, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; come ye, let us walk in the light of the Lord. So we get our thoughts right: we’re still dealing with thy kingdom come.

note.label: ​ | Sabbath Evening Class: Secrets in the Lord's Prayer

points: If those in the land today are the Jews of the Bible, here is something else that would be going on. “The mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills”. We have been to Israel: it is not at the top of no mountain, it is a desert in a valley, and that land is not exalted above no governments. “All nations shall flow unto it”: that is Israel coming out of all nations, and they ain’t flowing to that.

“For out of Zion shall go forth the law”. Is the law being taught out of there? No. All you got over there is hatred and racism, and they are knocking Palestinians upside their head and shooting them. They had the damn gay parade out there; they got pork stores out there, transgender LGBT marches. You’re an idiot if you think those people in Israel today are the prophetic fulfillment of the scriptures we read about.

Greg Laurie keeps using the word Jewish. He knows most people don’t look that word up. He is telling you the converts took the city: the Idumeans took the city when Jerusalem came under Jewish control in the ’67 war.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 2 Message to the 7 Churches

points: “And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.” When the twelve tribes of Israel return to the land there is going to be world peace. Is there world peace today? Hell no. So they are not the biblical Jews at all.

Foreign policy and the United Nations are trying to make everybody believe the move in 1948 was the establishment of the Jews, fighting biblical prophecy. Imagine the pandemonium when the world finds out that you are the real Jews all over this planet Earth. They are trying to stop that by establishing these people as the Jews.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 2 Message to the 7 Churches

points: I’m going to show you why the praise of God is going to be on the earth. “The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem”: this is concerning Judah and Jerusalem. This is what’s going to happen to us in the end; this is the prophecy.

note.label: | ESCAPE JUNETEENTH: Life After WW3

points: “And it shall come to pass in the last days”: the last days is after World War III, after the nations learn peace, after we subdue the nations and force them to serve the God of Israel, because they ain’t gonna do it willingly. What we’re reading here is something that’s going to take place in the future: the Lord is declaring the end from the beginning. The end is that the nation of Israel, you brothers and sisters that repent, are gonna be established over all the nations.

“The mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains”: on the top of the mountains, meaning above all nations. “And shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.”

People ask, are other nations going to be in the kingdom? They don’t care about the Chinese, the Africans or the Arabs; all they care about is, would the white man be in the kingdom. Tell them the kingdom of heaven is for the children of Israel and they say, you racist. The same way we are in their kingdom today, servants working 9 to 5, it’s the same way they’re going to be in the kingdom: servants, hard servants, building up the walls.

note.label: | ESCAPE JUNETEENTH: Life After WW3

points: “And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways”: all nations going to learn the commandments of God and they’re going to do them, every last one of these nations. There will be no homosexuals on this planet earth, no more lesbians, no more thief, no more nations warring with each other, because all nations gonna learn this. When the sabbath day comes there will be no buying and selling on the planet earth. His ways are the commandments; we’re going to teach them the commandments.
“And we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.”

note.label: | ESCAPE JUNETEENTH: Life After WW3

points: “And he shall judge among the nations”: that’s Christ. Christ is going to destroy the nations, as we read early on. Before the mountain of the Lord’s house can be established, Christ got to return and judge among the nations, and that’s in the midst of World War III. “And shall rebuke many people”: the many people are the nations, being rebuked.

“And they shall beat their swords into plowshares”: didn’t we just read that in Psalms? Their swords are their weapons, and they’re gonna turn them into farming equipment. Why? Because they’re going into slavery: time to plow the field. “And their spears into pruninghooks”: they gonna make farming equipment out of their weapons.

“Nation shall not lift up sword against nation”: when Christ returns and destroys these nations and rules this earth with the Israelites, nations are not going to be fighting with each other no more. You got China and Taiwan, Pakistan and India, Russia and Ukraine fighting; that ain’t gonna be happening no more.

“Neither shall they learn war any more”: Christ got to conquer these nations and destroy them, and that’s the only way nations ain’t going to learn war anymore. What we’re reading about here is the kingdom of heaven. When you so-called black men are ruling this earth, once you brothers stop fornicating and do what’s right, when Christ returns he’s gonna give you that power to rule these nations, and you’re gonna rule them righteously. They’re going to come up and learn the laws of the Most High God; all the nations gonna praise him, but they gonna be forced. Esau is gonna be in the kingdom, for a time, but that’s another topic.
We just went into the future and came back: that’s where the Bible is. That’s why the scripture says declaring the end from the beginning; I’m giving you all the end.
